quarterly_data.quarter: Kepler Communications press release: Kepler Successfully Launches First Tranche of Optical Relay (01-11-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Kepler's Tranche 1 consists of 10 satellites of approximately 300 kilograms each, with high-capacity SDA-compatible optical terminals and multi-GPU on-orbit compute modules with terabytes of storage; future tranches add 100-gigabit optical technology. Kepler has launched 33 satellites to date.
